analysis.reasonEn: Recent two consecutive sessions saw significant drops (-7.18%, -4.35%), pushing RSI down to 44.9, entering oversold territory. ADX at 12.5 indicates weak trend strength, with -DI exceeding +DI suggesting downside pressure, but not yet a confirmed trend. A Lower Low pattern is forming as the 5-day low (100,885) is higher than the 20-day low (94,350), indicating a continued weak trend. At 32.8% of the 52-week range, there is room for further decline.
